Vestigial_Theropod_Forelimbs.description: Comically small forelimbs relative to body mass. Virtually useless for fine manipulation or load-bearing, they serve only to slash wildly during extreme close-quarters grappling or mating displays, significantly reducing weight.

Raptorial_Grasping_Forelimbs.description: Long, highly flexible arms ending in three-fingered hands tipped with recurved talons. They are explicitly designed to latch onto much larger prey, acting as meat-hooks to secure a target tightly while the jaws work.
